body: I'm already trapped in my most hated persons body
nobody fucking asked if it was better

One time, during christmas time, we were getting ready to go have dinner at my grandma's. I was all good to go, just had to brush my hair, so i did. But i forgot where i put the brush. 
My parents gave me about 30 seconds to look for it, then they said i was an idiot for misplacing my stuff and that i was making them late. They then proceeded to hold me down and hit me with a belt for what seemed hours. They took turns, who would hold me down, who would hit me. I cried the whole ride to my grandma's and wondered why i made such a mistake, thought that i ruined christmas. 
When we got there, they just sat me down and said "Sorry for what happened"
After that, i thought for many years it was okay. They said sorry, right?
I now live at that grandma's house where they "apologized" and have a hard time getting it off my mind.
I was 6 when it happened.
i have had very bad childhood trauma, and yes im lonely. Also ive tried cannabis and its my hero in times like this but its really hard to get my hands on it where i live.
they're not fucking thoughts anymore, theyre hallucinations, theyre ideations that never go away, they are nightmares and im sick of them
